_about: The body of the LT zip (docs/animation/zip.md; Orb's prototype docs/ep/prototypes/lt-zip-v4.html; docs/design/melee-press-feel.md section 2c). Render only, outside the sim's data hash, and behind RenderAnim.press_styles (the same flag as the press styles: --press-styles, Shift+F7). The sim moves the fighter along the zip; the body only poses. readings: per press reading the default ticks of each phase when the zip's spec does not give them (the prototype's, with the floor of Legal's RL-076 on the tech reading (the way in and the way out each at least 4 ticks, the body drawn travelling on every tick): tell, in = the way in, hits blows of hd ticks each in reach, out = the way out), which poses play in each phase (run: the low run of the speed reading, run_clean: the tech reading's fast, upright, clean dash (the entry's skid run, upright and long in the stride), coil: the crouch of a wind-up, lunge: the stretched lunge, back: the back-step), how many after-images VFX is asked for (ghosts), the squash of the tell and the stretch of the way in (the press styles' numbers for the heavy). poses: the existing pose each name is, per fighter (the entries' dash, coil, spring and hop back) and the shared grab poses (wave pair2). orient: the body turns along its path: the most (rad), how fast (a rate), and the speed (units a second) under which it does not. pass: a far-side exit goes over (an arc dive) or round (a pivot) the rival, entry names played at the zip's speed (a spec's `pass`); a spec's `entry_in` and `entry_out`, or a reading's, name an entry of his own played at zip speed over the way in or out. carry: the rival's cosmetic lift in a held throw (model units).
_ends: How the body leaves a zip (zip.md section 15), by the word zip_end carried: the last zip pose is blended away over `blend` ticks (the stance or the reaction takes over; 0 leaves it to the next layer), and `overcommit` carries an outrun zipper past, off balance, as a whiff does. done is the way out running its ticks; a caught, countered or shot zipper is left to the damage events; down is the drop (the fall is the tumble's).
_arrival: In reach, until the strike block's own cut wind-up starts, the zipper stands in his arrival: the travel pose settled toward the tell pose by `settle`, the stretch released.
_dropped: A zipper shot down on his way out (SimFighter.drop: state dropped; zip.md section 10). The fall is the tumble's body. land_w is the weight of the soft catch (gc.hold.brace_tumble) when he reaches the ground (nothing hurts), held until the drop ends; tech maps the sim's word on drop_end to an entry (a word with none plays as end).
